name: 99202 · Spokane, WA
findings: ZIP 99202 (Spokane) has 144 nonprofit organizations. 80 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 59 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 99202 (Spokane) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 99202 (Spokane) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 47 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
